_doc: Data shape -> THE representation. Ordered, first match wins — deterministic, so the same shape always gets the same chart (never varied for variety). The generator evaluates these against the envelope + intent; the LLM never picks a chart type. Shape terms: T = temporal dim/grain present, C = categorical dims count, low/high = dim cardinality, F = facts on the view.

rules.note: retention/repeat shape: rows = cohort (e.g. first_order_month), columns = periods since; values printed, sequential ramp
journey/funnel flows between stage dims; additive fact only (counts, spend) — never a ratio
both splits matter AND share matters; the honest pie replacement for two dims
exact values / operational drill-down asked for by name ('show me the table', 'exact numbers')
numbers never stand alone: delta vs previous period always on; target delta when a per-account target exists
one line per member; > ~6 members would be spaghetti -> rank instead (next rules)
few known members (placement, device, os): side-by-side vertical bars; add share chips when intent=composition and fact is additive
rankings: campaigns, products, keywords — 10 then Show more
entity x dimension efficiency grid; 5-step sequential ramp, values printed, invert-aware
exact values / full metric sets / anything the rules above don't own. Never wrong, just dense

constraints.banned_reason: spatial-area comparison is unreadable (do's/don'ts); composition uses bars_v+share, marimekko, or table
constraints.consistency: same shape -> same chart, across the whole product; variety is a bug not a feature
constraints.context: every rendered number carries comparative context: delta vs previous period (and vs target when configured); compare defaults ON for kpi and line
constraints.precision: money 0 dp, rates 2 dp, ratios 1 dp (x) — from the basic repo's primitives rules; never more
constraints.status_color: green/red on deltas ONLY, inverted for lower-is-better facts (acos, cpc, cpi, cost_per_conv); never on chart marks
constraints.data_ink: no gridlines beyond one horizontal style, no chart borders/backgrounds, no icons in charts, no in-chart prose (a single note chip max)
constraints.facts_per_chart: max 2 (tables exempt); a second fact needs compatible units or goes to its own card
constraints.grouping: related facts stay on one card (the metric selector), never scattered across cards
constraints.non_additive: ratios and uniques (roas, reach, frequency, ctr) never stack, never size a marimekko, never sum across platforms; cross-platform views are additive facts only per measurement.yaml
constraints.provisional: days inside the platform settled window render labeled provisional, never as final
